description: Four hooks. SessionStart injects the derived deficit → resolution table once per context epoch (startup, resume, clear, compact), and the premise index beneath it with every path absolute — scripts/route-session.mjs. UserPromptSubmit carries the per-prompt firing conditions for /route, for a deficit held in the request and for one the accumulated context shows alike, and narrows /route to monitor mode while a gate holds the user's judgment — scripts/route-prompt.mjs. PreToolUse delivers a premise entry again at the tool call the matcher decides is its moment — scripts/route-tool.mjs. Stop holds the turn's end once when the message that just ended presented a numbered option set, handing the genuine-choice test back to the model for a second pass; it reads the set's shape off last_assistant_message and passes every stop_hook_active stop through — scripts/route-stop.mjs. Only `description` and `hooks` go in this file: Codex rejects any other top-level key and then registers none of these hooks.
